claire (CSE): Heads-up: HorizonGrid onboarding summarize endpoint p95 ~2600ms, our SLO is 600ms. Renewal flagged as sensitive.
ben (SRE): Hosted or dedicated? model variant and token distribution?
syl (ML Eng): Hosted, model redwood-open-xl-v2 (recent pin). Heavy long-tail: many docs 3k-5k tokens. KV cache misses on repeated headers.
claire (CSE): They upload nightly batches; saw a spike last three evenings.
omar (AE): Customer wants latency first, cost second. Might consider private later.
ben (SRE): Ops quick wins: enable route-level prefix KV cache (TTL=24h) and lower concurrency on that route for bursts.
syl (ML Eng): Proposed experiment: 1) Canary a quantized int8 build (redwood-open-xl-v2-int8) scoped to HorizonGrid at 10%. 2) Add routing rule: if input_tokens > 2800 -> redwood-compact-xl-qa (canary 15%). 3) Run a 30-sample eval and monitor ROUGE-L and exact-match on their QA checks.
claire (CSE): Please draft a short customer note explaining the pilot, rollback, and expected timeline. Keep it plain English.
omar (AE): I'll schedule a 30m sync and request 12 example docs plus their acceptance metric.
eng-runtime-bot: deploy request queued: canary redwood-open-xl-v2-int8 -> 10% via policy "horizongrid-int8-pilot".
syl (ML Eng): Eval snapshot (30 samples):
```
redwood-open-xl-v2 (float): p95 2600ms, ROUGE-L 0.745, EM 0.62
redwood-open-xl-v2-int8: p95 1100ms, ROUGE-L 0.737, EM 0.61
redwood-compact-xl-qa: p95 950ms, ROUGE-L 0.702, EM 0.58
```
syl (ML Eng): Notes: int8 reduces tail by ~57% with ~1% ROUGE-L drop; compact model is fastest for >3k tokens but small QA fidelity loss on edge cases.
ben (SRE): I'll enable cache and stage routing rule. Will add dashboard for p95/cost/ROUGE and an alert: ROUGE-L delta >1.5% -> notify @syl @claire.
claire (CSE): Customer message draft: "We propose a short pilot to cut tail latency: test a quantized variant and optionally route very long documents to a compact model. We'll monitor quality and can revert immediately." Agree?
omar (AE): Good. Add FAQ: expected monthly cost delta, rollback steps, and sample failure modes. If pilot accepted, offer a 3-month reserved discount for renewal.
syl (ML Eng): Rollback plan: set canary to 0%, remove routing rule; maintain A/B eval dashboard. We'll gate full rollout on ROUGE-L drop <1.0% and EM drop <0.02.
ben (SRE): Ops checklist: [x] Prefix KV cache enabled (TTL=24h) [x] Concurrency throttle applied [x] Int8 canary queued [x] Routing rule staged [ ] Monitoring dashboard live - ETA EOD.
eng-runtime-bot: ticket CS-99887 updated: owners set (Syl, Ben, Omar, Claire). Canary window 12h.
claire (CSE): Owners: Syl=evals & quality, Ben=ops & dashboards, Omar=customer comms/renewal, Claire=enablement doc. I'll post the customer note after Omar confirms meeting time.
omar (AE): Will capture their 12 example docs on the call and confirm acceptance criteria.
ben (SRE): I'll watch the canary metrics and escalate if KV hit < 20% after 6h.
syl (ML Eng): Sending eval artifacts to the ticket. Keeping quality-first.
claire (CSE): Thanks team. Ping here for any critical alerts during the canary. :thumbsup:
